description: This file defines the ServiceEcaAction class, which represents an action triggered by an event in the OFBiz framework's Event-Condition-Action (ECA) system. It encapsulates logic for executing service calls in response to events, handling parameters, transaction modes, and error processing.

classes.name: ServiceEcaAction
classes.description: Represents an event-triggered action that runs a service in the OFBiz framework, with configurable parameters for execution mode, transaction, error handling, and result integration.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to be invoked.

methods.name: getServiceMode
methods.description: Returns the mode (sync or async) in which the service should be executed.

methods.name: isPersist
methods.description: Indicates whether the service invocation should persist data.

methods.name: getShortDisplayDescription
methods.description: Provides a brief string description of the action for display or logging.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the configured service action in response to an event, handling parameters, execution mode, error states, and updating result and context accordingly.
